scientific_integrity: Proof and finite reproducibility checks reviewed in one mathematical review; no independent audit or independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-block formulas rely on one-digit prime zero sets and do not compute those sets uniformly. Growth of neighboring gcds is in natural density, not pointwise. Full Eu-Liu-Yeh source was inaccessible and broader automatic-sequence literature could imply the count.
title: Exact simultaneous prime divisibility of neighboring central Delannoy numbers
